title: Immune Defense
description: A chess-inspired strategy game where you command the human immune system against a viral invasion. Deploy your Thymus, T-Cells, Macrophages, Antibodies, NK Cells, and White Blood Cells across the body's internal battlefield. Neutralize pathogens, secure vital organs, and build immune strength to reach a valuation of $10M to achieve total immunity.
learning_objectives: Understand the roles of different immune cells in the human body's defense system
Develop strategic thinking through coordinated immune responses and resource management
Learn how the innate and adaptive immune systems work together to fight infection
Practice risk assessment when deploying critical immune cells against pathogens
Explore how lymph nodes, bone marrow, and other organs support immune function
Recognize how immune memory and cell specialization create layered biological defense
how_to_play: Each turn you get 2 Action Points (AP). Moving an immune cell costs 1 AP, and using a special ability costs AP as listed on the ability.

Immune cells move like chess pieces: Thymus moves 1 square any direction, T-Cell moves any distance in any direction, Macrophages move in straight lines, Antibodies move diagonally, NK Cells leap in L-shapes, and White Blood Cells advance forward only.
Destroy pathogens by moving onto their square. White Blood Cells differentiate into T-Cells when they reach the far end of the body.
Secure organ tiles like Lymph Nodes and Bone Marrow by placing your immune cells on them. Each organ generates immune strength income per turn.
Win by neutralizing the enemy Thymus, securing 3 or more organ sites, or reaching $10M immune strength valuation.
Use special abilities strategically — the Thymus can rally nearby cells with a cytokine storm, NK Cells can deploy decoy markers, and White Blood Cells can heal injured allies through cell repair.
objectives: Neutralize the rival Thymus to cause total immune collapse in the enemy
Secure 3 or more vital organ sites for an immune domination victory
Build your immune strength valuation to $10 million for total immunity

storybook_pages.title: Infection Detected
storybook_pages.text: A dangerous pathogen has breached the body's outer defenses. The immune system activates in full force — Thymus command center, T-Cells, Macrophages, Antibodies, NK Cells, and legions of White Blood Cells mobilize for war. Every lymph node, every organ is a strategic position. The body's survival depends on your command of the immune response.
storybook_pages.image_prompt: Microscopic view of immune cells mobilizing inside the human body, white blood cells and T-cells glowing with bioluminescence, pathogens approaching from the darkness, dramatic medical illustration style with vibrant blues and reds

storybook_pages.title: Your Immune Arsenal
storybook_pages.text:
Thymus (King) — The command center of immunity. Lose it and the body falls.
T-Cell (Queen) — The adaptive immune system's most lethal weapon, strikes in any direction.
Macrophage (Rook) — Engulfs threats along straight corridors with relentless efficiency.
Antibody (Bishop) — Targets pathogens from diagonal angles with precision binding.
NK Cell (Knight) — Natural killer that leaps unpredictably to eliminate infected cells.
White Blood Cell (Pawn) — First responders in vast numbers, differentiating into T-Cells at the front lines!
storybook_pages.image_prompt: Six immune cell types arranged as game character portraits: a glowing thymus organ, a T-cell with receptor arms, a large green macrophage, a Y-shaped antibody, a spiky NK cell, and a round white blood cell, each in a medical-themed frame with stats, colorful scientific illustration game art

storybook_pages.title: Defend the Body
storybook_pages.text: The battlefield is an 8x8 grid of the body's interior with 6 critical organ sites: Lymph Nodes, Bone Marrow, Spleen, Blood Streams, Mucous Membranes, and Gut Flora colonies. Securing these organs fuels your immune response with vital resources. Push your White Blood Cells to the front lines to differentiate them into powerful T-Cells. The body's fate is in your hands — mount the perfect immune defense.
storybook_pages.image_prompt: Birds-eye view of a stylized 8x8 game board representing the inside of a human body, glowing organ tiles for lymph nodes bone marrow spleen blood and gut, immune cells positioned like chess pieces, medical-fantasy board game art with glowing neon cell structures

strengths.name: Cytokine Signal
strengths.desc: Boosts activation of adjacent immune cells, granting +1 ATK to each nearby ally

strengths.name: Immune Surveillance
strengths.desc: Cannot be ambushed — the thymus detects all nearby pathogenic threats

strengths.name: T-Cell Production
strengths.desc: Generates +$50K immune strength per turn by continuously producing new T-cells

weaknesses.name: Critical Organ
weaknesses.desc: If the Thymus is destroyed, the immune system collapses — instant loss

weaknesses.name: Stationary Organ
weaknesses.desc: Can only shift 1 square in any direction — relies on mobile cells for defense

weaknesses.name: Autoimmune Risk
weaknesses.desc: Loses 1 HP per turn if surrounded by enemy pathogens on multiple sides

abilities.name: Cytokine Storm
abilities.desc: Release a surge of cytokines that boost all adjacent immune cells +2 ATK for 1 turn

abilities.name: Immune Scan
abilities.desc: Scan all enemy pathogens to reveal their abilities and weaknesses

strengths.name: Omnidirectional Hunt
strengths.desc: Moves in any direction, any distance — the most versatile immune cell on the field

strengths.name: Receptor Lock
strengths.desc: +2 ATK when engaging NK Cells or White Blood Cells due to precise antigen recognition

strengths.name: Immune Memory
strengths.desc: Cannot be displaced or pushed by Antibody abilities — T-cells hold their ground

weaknesses.name: Isolation Weakness
weaknesses.desc: -1 ATK if no friendly cells within 2 squares — T-cells function best in coordinated response

weaknesses.name: Activation Cost
weaknesses.desc: Each ability use costs +1 extra AP next turn from metabolic expenditure

weaknesses.name: Patrol Instinct
weaknesses.desc: Cannot remain on the same tile for 2 consecutive turns — always patrolling for threats

abilities.name: Rapid Migration
abilities.desc: Migrate rapidly through tissue to any empty tile within 3 squares

abilities.name: Cell Repair
abilities.desc: Activate cellular repair mechanisms to restore +3 HP

strengths.name: Phagocytosis Corridor
strengths.desc: Moves in straight lines with unlimited range — engulfs everything in its path

strengths.name: Antigen Presentation
strengths.desc: +$100K immune strength bonus when destroying any enemy pathogen

strengths.name: Tissue Resident
strengths.desc: Cannot be destroyed if adjacent to a secured organ site you control

weaknesses.name: Linear Movement
weaknesses.desc: Cannot move or attack diagonally — blind to flanking pathogens

weaknesses.name: Nutrient Dependency
weaknesses.desc: Loses 1 HP per turn if not adjacent to a secured organ site

weaknesses.name: Momentum Required
weaknesses.desc: Must move at least 2 squares when changing position — no micro-adjustments

abilities.name: Nutrient Absorption
abilities.desc: Absorb nutrients from any adjacent organ site for instant immune strength income

abilities.name: Suppressive Signal
abilities.desc: Emit a suppressive signal that weakens an enemy within 3 squares by -2 ATK

strengths.name: Diagonal Binding
strengths.desc: Controls long diagonals — masters of precise cross-tissue targeting of antigens

strengths.name: Opsonization Aura
strengths.desc: Enemies adjacent to the Antibody suffer -1 ATK as they are tagged for destruction

strengths.name: Complement Cascade
strengths.desc: Pushing a pathogen into another pathogen damages both through complement activation

weaknesses.name: No Straight Paths
weaknesses.desc: Cannot move horizontally or vertically — limited to diagonal trajectories through tissue

weaknesses.name: Titer Dependent
weaknesses.desc: -2 ATK if immune strength valuation drops below $2M from low antibody concentration

weaknesses.name: Vulnerable to Mutation
weaknesses.desc: Takes +1 extra damage from T-Cell attacks due to antigenic drift

abilities.name: Neutralization Push
abilities.desc: Bind to an enemy pathogen and push it 2 squares away through neutralization force

abilities.name: Opsonization Swap
abilities.desc: Tag a friendly cell for repositioning — swap positions with any ally on the board

strengths.name: Cytotoxic Leap
strengths.desc: Unique L-shaped movement that leaps over other cells — unpredictable and lethal

strengths.name: Perforin Strike
strengths.desc: +2 ATK when attacking from an unexpected angle — NK cells punch holes in cell membranes

strengths.name: Innate Armor
strengths.desc: Takes -1 damage from all attacks due to natural resistance and rapid granule release

weaknesses.name: Limited Landing Zones
weaknesses.desc: Only 8 possible landing positions per move — can be predicted and blocked by pathogens

weaknesses.name: Degranulation Cooldown
weaknesses.desc: Cannot use special abilities on two consecutive turns — needs time to reload granules

weaknesses.name: Patrol Pattern
weaknesses.desc: Cannot return to a previous position within 2 turns — always seeking new infected cells

abilities.name: Deploy Cytokine Marker
abilities.desc: Place an inflammatory marker on any empty adjacent tile that blocks pathogen movement

abilities.name: Killer Frenzy
abilities.desc: Enter a cytotoxic frenzy and move again immediately — uses all remaining AP

strengths.name: Proliferation
strengths.desc: +1 ATK for each turn survived as the cell matures and activates (stacks up to +3)

strengths.name: Strength in Numbers
strengths.desc: You deploy 8 white blood cells — overwhelm pathogens with sheer immune volume

strengths.name: Differentiation Path
strengths.desc: Reaching the far end of the body differentiates the White Blood Cell into a powerful T-Cell

weaknesses.name: Forward Migration Only
weaknesses.desc: Can only move forward toward the infection site, never retreat backward

weaknesses.name: Fragile Membrane
weaknesses.desc: Only 3 HP — easily lysed by any aggressive pathogen

weaknesses.name: Diagonal Engagement Only
weaknesses.desc: Can only attack diagonally, not while migrating straight forward

abilities.name: Cell Repair Signal
abilities.desc: Release healing growth factors to restore +3 HP to any adjacent allied cell

abilities.name: Leukocyte Rolling
abilities.desc: Roll along the endothelium to swap position with any adjacent friendly White Blood Cell

rounds.title: Immune Defense
rounds.story: A deadly pathogen has invaded the body. The immune system must mount a coordinated defense — secure the lymph nodes, protect the thymus, and differentiate your white blood cells into lethal T-cells. The body's survival depends on your strategic command of the immune response!
rounds.coaching_moment: Think carefully about the trade-offs before committing to this path.

glossary_terms.definition: The process of selecting among alternatives based on available information and values.
glossary_terms.example: Choosing between two career paths based on income, passion, and long-term growth.
glossary_terms.deep_dive: Good decision-making combines rational analysis with awareness of cognitive biases that distort judgment.
glossary_terms.real_world_example: Leaders make high-stakes decisions daily — the quality of their process matters as much as the decision itself.

glossary_terms.definition: Analyzing information objectively to form a well-reasoned judgment.
glossary_terms.example: Questioning whether a statistic is representative before using it to make a decision.
glossary_terms.deep_dive: Critical thinking involves identifying assumptions, evaluating evidence, and considering alternative perspectives.
glossary_terms.real_world_example: Journalists fact-check before publishing; scientists replicate experiments before claiming discoveries.

glossary_terms.definition: The belief that abilities can be developed through effort and learning from failure.
glossary_terms.example: Seeing a poor game result as feedback on what to practice, not evidence of being bad at the game.
glossary_terms.deep_dive: Research by Carol Dweck shows people with growth mindsets achieve more and recover better from setbacks.
glossary_terms.real_world_example: Students who believe intelligence is fixed give up when challenged; those with growth mindset persist and improve.
